cause: Pointer hover was recomputed against the old window bounds while caption capture moved the window underneath the pointer. A desktop item and its full-name header could highlight during the drag, then clear on release.
correction: Suppress ordinary hover while a caption/grip capture or window drag owns the pointer. File drag destination hover remains available.
qualification: Repeat exact-media native/empty/controller/startup and cached/full checks on the corrected build; prior passing groups do not qualify changed bytes.
